defs.meaning: 修复（repair 的 ing 形式）；修理

examples.en: He was busily engaged repairing his bike.
examples.zh: 他正忙着修他的自行车。

examples.en: They were very worried about the cost of repairing the leaky roof.
examples.zh: 他们非常担心维修漏雨屋顶的费用。

examples.en: It was up to the US to take the initiative in repairing relations.
examples.zh: 在修复关系方面应由美国采取主动。
